q: The property 'very weak Bernoulli' (VWB) was introduced by Ornstein as a sufficient condition for a system to be:
exp: VWB (very weak Bernoulli) is Ornstein's condition generalizing 'processes that approximate i.i.d.' Any VWB process is Bernoulli. Geodesic flows on compact surfaces of negative curvature are VWB (hence Bernoulli).
